description: This file defines a C++ class 'FWUPGRADEHAL' which acts as a stub interface for firmware upgrade functionalities, including method bindings for JSON-RPC calls, within a testing framework for a firmware upgrade HAL. It declares methods for initializing, cleaning up, and various firmware upgrade operations, as well as associated includes and licensing info.

classes.name: FWUPGRADEHAL
classes.description: A class that provides a stub implementation for firmware upgrade operations, inheriting from RDKTestStubInterface and AbstractServer, with methods for initializing, cleaning up, and handling JSON-RPC calls for firmware upgrade procedures.

methods.name: FWUPGRADEHAL_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Handles retrieving a parameter of unsigned long type via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: FWUPGRADEHAL_Set_Download_Interface
methods.description: Sets the download interface for firmware upgrade process via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: FWUPGRADEHAL_Download
methods.description: Initiates the download process of the firmware via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: FWUPGRADEHAL_Reboot_Now
methods.description: Commands an immediate reboot for firmware upgrade via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: FWUPGRADEHAL_Get_Download_Url
methods.description: Retrieves the current download URL via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: FWUPGRADEHAL_Set_Download_Url
methods.description: Sets the download URL and filename for firmware upgrade via JSON-RPC.

methods.name: FWUPGRADEHAL_Update_And_FactoryReset
methods.description: Performs an update and factory reset operation via JSON-RPC.
